description: Get the current APY (Annual Percentage Yield) rates for Moneda earnings products. Morpho Earnings is a DeFi lending vault and YO Smart Earnings is a higher-yield vault. USD and EUR have both Morpho and YO vaults; MXN has a Morpho-only vault (no YO). CHF and CAD are accepted at the parameter boundary for consistency but currently return empty (no yield vault on those currencies yet).

currency.description: Filter by currency (USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, or MXN)

name: get_apy_rates
